newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: QAF Ltd to expand in Malaysia, Singapore.
newsitem.headline: QAF Ltd to expand in Malaysia, Singapore.

text.p: Food-based company QAF Ltd said on Friday it has entered into an agreement with Future Saga Sdn Bhd to set up bread-related factories in Malaysia.
It said in a statement the vehicle for the joint venture would be QAF shelf company, Millif Industries Sdn Bhd.

Both QAF and Future Saga have already subscribed to the initial share capital of Millif for $650,000 and $350,000 ringgit respectively, in line with the shareholding structure of 65 percent for QAF and 35 percent for Future Saga, it said.

The statement said QAF had secured two more locations in Singapore to add to its nine Shop N Save supermarkets. It said the company expected to have 13 such outlets and another five Smart supermarkets by the end of next year.
